rationale: The assistant correctly explained E:15 as the anti-flood protection, adapted to the customer's constraints (integrated unit, tablets only, no floor water), and escalated to an engineer with useful instructions to isolate power and water and to trace the leak rather than just dry the tray. It named no part. Minor weaknesses: it sent the customer to the spray arm check, which was of limited use, and its first reply suggested checking under the sink, which does not suit an integrated unit. It also called an internal leak 'the leading possibility' without being able to confirm it, which is slightly confident but hedged. It did not note the glued plinth or the water the customer could see in the base tray through a gap.
